sample_data.reset_instructions: Reload the application and select a public P08 fixture case. PUB-01 is the preferred default case.

problem_solving_method: The team split ownership across P08 and P06 and worked in parallel. For P08, ResultGuard was developed from the domain rules outward: deterministic grading and GPA rules were implemented first, edge cases were verified with automated tests, and the React interface was then built around result visibility, calculation explainability, pre-publication checking, analytics, import validation and printing. The final release was verified with automated tests, linting, a production build and live deployment checks.

R1.evidence: Core grading and GPA engine: src/domain/grade.ts, src/domain/subjectResult.ts, src/domain/studentResult.ts; verified by src/tests/grade.test.ts, src/tests/subjectResult.test.ts and src/tests/studentResult.test.ts.

R2.evidence: Practical-component, AB/absence and edge-case handling: src/domain/subjectResult.ts with automated coverage in src/tests/subjectResult.test.ts and src/tests/studentResult.test.ts.

R3.evidence: Per-student explainable result and calculation-trace workflow implemented in src/App.tsx using the deterministic domain result engine.

R4.evidence: Pre-publication Optional Review, Practical Fail and Absent checking lists implemented in src/domain/checkingLists.ts and the application UI, with automated coverage in src/tests/checkingLists.test.ts.

major_design_decisions: Separated deterministic result-calculation logic from React presentation code so domain rules can be tested independently.
Represented AB as a distinct result state instead of treating absence as numeric zero.
Applied compulsory-subject failure as a final-result override while retaining the uncancelled GPA calculation for explainability.
Loaded the organizer-provided P08 fixture as same-origin bundled data so the deployed application has no runtime backend or external API dependency.
Kept marks import validation non-destructive: uploaded or pasted rows are validated and previewed but do not replace the bundled evaluation fixture.
Used browser print functionality for printable marksheets instead of introducing a separate PDF-generation dependency.
known_limitations: Binary .xlsx files are not parsed directly; spreadsheet data can be pasted as tab-delimited text and CSV/TXT files can be validated.
Accepted imported marks are validation/preview only and are not persisted or applied to replace the currently loaded fixture.
The application has no authentication, backend database or multi-user persistence layer.
Data and calculations run client-side in the browser.
